scopeBoundary: This document is a conceptual reference for 20 platform interaction steps. No maintained harness binds all these interactions into one evidence chain. They include Prism Studio approval, a Nova project run, Discord, Redis, Cilium, Hubble, and Buster BuildKit/Tailscale work. The deployment success exercise gives evidence only for its compiled Nova project and final Buster demo chain. Until a joined harness exists, Prism, human channels, Redis, Cilium, and Hubble must have their separate maintained checks.
purpose: This reference gives the intended complete-showcase sequence and the evidence that a future joined acceptance harness must bind. It is not an execution record.
startingConditions: The operator must select one deployment profile and one specified Git revision.

For this exercise, the selected deployment must have the configuration for all these components: K3s, Cilium, SPIRE, Envoy, Redis, and both PostgreSQL domains. It must also have the configuration for LiteLLM, Vertex credentials, Discord, Tailscale, BuildKit, the writable registry, and Docker Hub mirror.
The deployment supplies Buster with an explicit writable-registry and Docker Hub mirror client contract.
A future joined harness supplies the missing same-run Prism, Nova, Buster, channel, and network bindings described by this reference.
Each standalone BuildKit, registry, Tailscale, Prism, role, channel, or network check gives evidence only for its scope. Documentation alone cannot join them into one result.
liveEvidenceRequiredForAcceptance: selected values and immutable workload revisions
K3s, Cilium, SPIRE SVID, Envoy peer, and route evidence
Git commit and verified source-tree digest
Nova run, stage, attempt, effect, wait, signal, import, and terminal records
Prism Agent dispatch, Control request and job, Worker receipt, PostgreSQL transaction, artifact, selection, and approval identities
LiteLLM database health and a Vertex embedding result that agrees with its contract
Buster job, plan, node, result, cleanup, and evidence records
Redis stream entry and deduplication identities
BuildKit worker result and immutable OCI manifest digest
Tailscale route and fixture lease generations plus release receipts

steps.evidenceStatus: This step is a reference. It has no live evidence attached.
steps.inputIdentity: selected profile, immutable release receipts, and target namespace
steps.action: Before reconciliation, select the CNI, storage classes, and registry endpoints. Also select the mirror endpoint, secrets, and one deployment owner. Do not select a second deployment owner.
steps.outputIdentity: selected values digest and deployment revision
steps.safeStop: Stop before workload admission when ownership or an immutable input is unresolved.

steps.evidenceStatus: This step is a reference. It has no live evidence attached.
steps.inputIdentity: selected cluster and secured network profile
steps.action: Provide API, scheduling, DNS, storage, Pod networking, and the checked-in allowed and denied routes.
steps.outputIdentity: node, CNI policy, allowed flow, and denied flow evidence
steps.safeStop: Do not claim network enforcement from rendered manifests or ready Pods without live positive and negative flows.

steps.evidenceStatus: This step is a reference. It has no live evidence attached.
steps.inputIdentity: namespace and ServiceAccount selectors for Nova, Buster, Prism Agent, Control, and Worker
steps.action: Issue SVIDs with rotation. Authenticate each protected hop. Applications must accept forwarded identity only from loopback.
steps.outputIdentity: SPIFFE IDs, SVID generations, and authenticated peer records
steps.decisionOwner: SPIRE and each receiving application allowlist
steps.safeStop: Stop protected traffic on missing, stale, wrong, or caller-supplied identity.

steps.evidenceStatus: This step is a reference. It has no live evidence attached.
steps.component: Writable OCI registry and Docker Hub mirror
steps.inputIdentity: selected registry-client contract and digest-pinned upstream reference
steps.action: Do a check of the selected endpoints. Do a cold pull through the mirror. For the writable registry, do push, digest read, and pull checks.
steps.outputIdentity: registry-client contract digest, upstream digest, and produced manifest digest
steps.decisionOwner: The registry has authority for stored blobs. The consuming check has authority for acceptance.
steps.safeStop: Do not substitute a tag, an insecure endpoint, or endpoint health for digest verification.

steps.evidenceStatus: This step is a reference. It has no live evidence attached.
steps.inputIdentity: redis-secrets/redis-password and bounded stream probe identity
steps.action: Authenticate. Send the PING command. Make sure that the response is PONG. Append one bounded observation with its deduplication identity.
steps.outputIdentity: stream key, entry ID, and deduplication key
steps.decisionOwner: Redis has authority for the transport entry. Nova and Buster retain lifecycle authority.
steps.safeStop: Do not reconstruct pipeline state from Redis or erase canonical state when a projection is missing.

steps.evidenceStatus: This step is a reference. It has no live evidence attached.
steps.inputIdentity: separate database releases, credentials, volumes, and owner-specific probes
steps.action: Do a check of each database for readiness, persistent volume, and distinct runtime identity. Do not use one database's restore domain for the other database.
steps.outputIdentity: LiteLLM database check and Prism database check with separate volume identities
steps.safeStop: Stop the affected domain. Do not use one database backup or credential set for the other.

steps.evidenceStatus: This step is a reference. It has no live evidence attached.
steps.inputIdentity: consumer key, master key, database, Google service-account identity, and model gemini-embedding-001
steps.action: Route one authenticated embedding request. Validate that the response contains a bounded numeric vector.
steps.outputIdentity: model identity and validated vector result bound to the requesting session
steps.decisionOwner: LiteLLM has authority for gateway state. Vertex has authority for the provider result.
steps.safeStop: Keep the consumer operation incomplete after authentication, quota, timeout, model, or vector failure.

steps.evidenceStatus: This step is a reference. It has no live evidence attached.
steps.inputIdentity: distinct bot tokens, channel IDs, allowed user, and denied user
steps.action: For each enabled channel, do a check of one allowed message. Also do a check of one attempt from a denied user.
steps.outputIdentity: Discord message IDs and receiving OpenClaw session identities
steps.safeStop: A delivered message cannot create a pipeline transition without Nova admission.

steps.evidenceStatus: This step is a reference. It has no live evidence attached.
steps.inputIdentity: allowed Discord message and configured managed reasoning session
steps.action: Prepare the requested workflow input. Admit it through Nova Core. Create the canonical run journal.
steps.outputIdentity: OpenClaw session, runId, request digest, and initial journal record
steps.safeStop: Do not treat a model answer or chat acknowledgement as run admission.

steps.evidenceStatus: This step is a reference. It has no live evidence attached.
steps.inputIdentity: repository URL, mounted deploy-key identity, and requested immutable revision
steps.action: Fetch the selected objects. Verify the commit and source tree. Before execution, store source identity.
steps.outputIdentity: commit ID and verified source-tree digest
steps.decisionOwner: Nova Core accepts or rejects source identity
steps.safeStop: Do not replace the required commit with a branch head or stale local checkout.

steps.evidenceStatus: This step is a reference. It has no live evidence attached.
steps.inputIdentity: runId, stageId, attemptId, architecture artifact digest, and phase
steps.action: Record the attempt. Reserve a runtime-dispatch effect. The stage makes its idempotency key from the run, architecture digest, and phase.
steps.outputIdentity: effect ID, idempotency key, and dispatch request digest
steps.safeStop: The durable effect reservation must exist before protected transport begins.

steps.evidenceStatus: This step is a reference. It has no live evidence attached.
steps.component: Nova Envoy and Prism Agent Envoy/bridge
steps.inputIdentity: Nova SPIFFE ID, Prism Agent SPIFFE ID, and the reserved dispatch request
steps.action: Carry the request through Nova loopback Envoy, the agent-prism mTLS listener, its loopback bridge, and the second Envoy hop to Control.
steps.outputIdentity: authenticated Nova-to-Agent and Agent-to-Control peer evidence
steps.decisionOwner: Prism Agent and Control peer allowlists
steps.safeStop: Reconcile the same dispatch identity after an uncertain response. Do not create another design round.

steps.evidenceStatus: This step is a reference. It has no live evidence attached.
steps.inputIdentity: authenticated agent peer, body digest, idempotency key, preference subject, schema, and architecture revision
steps.action: Validate the request. Before you return waiting state, commit the project, design request, preference generation, and agent job.
steps.outputIdentity: project ID, request digest, generation, agent job ID, and PostgreSQL transaction
steps.safeStop: Reject stale revisions, changed idempotent bytes, invalid peers, and uncommitted jobs.

steps.evidenceStatus: This step is a reference. It has no live evidence attached.
steps.inputIdentity: durable job ID, stable project session, claim expiry, and fence
steps.action: Claim the job once. Start one bounded OpenClaw attempt. Return three designs bound to job, generation, and fence. Do not return other designs.
steps.outputIdentity: claim, runner, attempt envelope, fence, session, and three design digests
steps.safeStop: An uncertain launch becomes needs_nova. Do not spawn a replacement agent for the same claim.

steps.evidenceStatus: This step is a reference. It has no live evidence attached.
steps.inputIdentity: fenced design result and accepted Worker attempt envelope
steps.action: Lock the result. Validate the result. Execute any bounded native work through the protected Worker route. Then commit the digest, Worker receipt, and terminal job state.
steps.outputIdentity: Worker attempt receipt, design digests, and terminal Prism job record
steps.safeStop: A model response, render output, or process exit alone is not a committed Prism result.

steps.evidenceStatus: This step is a reference. It has no live evidence attached.
steps.component: Tailscale, Prism Studio, and Prism Control
steps.inputIdentity: private hostname, Tailnet identity, signed application session, project, and selected design digest
steps.action: Open Studio through its private access route. Create the application session. Select one direction. Give approval for its digest.
steps.outputIdentity: route identity, session, selection revision, and approval record
steps.safeStop: Do not bypass private access, product authorization, CSRF, or revision checks.

steps.evidenceStatus: This step is a reference. It has no live evidence attached.
steps.inputIdentity: active wait ID, authorized resume signal, approved revision, and deterministic next-phase key
steps.action: Resume the original run. Fetch the approved content-addressed archive. Before import, verify its manifest and object digests.
steps.outputIdentity: signal ID, baseline archive digest, imported artifact ID, and resumed attempt
steps.safeStop: Reject stale signals and digest mismatches. Do not manufacture a replacement baseline.

steps.evidenceStatus: This step is a reference. It has no live evidence attached.
steps.component: Nova to Buster and Tailscale fixture
steps.inputIdentity: runId, stageId, attemptId, signed source snapshot, plan digest, job idempotency key, and private fixture request
steps.action: Send one immutable Buster job. Admit it once. Only when a fixture lease is necessary in the plan, allocate one generation-bound private fixture lease.
steps.outputIdentity: Buster jobId, accepted request digest, lease ID, generation, and fixture endpoint
steps.decisionOwner: Buster has authority for job admission and the fixture lease. Nova has authority for the pipeline attempt.
steps.safeStop: Reconcile the same job and lease after an uncertain response. Do not allocate replacements.

steps.evidenceStatus: This step is a reference. It has no live evidence attached.
steps.component: Worker Core, rootless BuildKit, mirror, and writable OCI registry
steps.inputIdentity: accepted attempt envelope, capability grant, registry-client contract, local BuildKit socket, and digest-pinned source
steps.action: Build through Worker Core. Use the selected mirror for eligible upstream content. Push to the selected registry. Verify the immutable manifest digest.
steps.outputIdentity: attempt receipt, BuildKit result, upstream digest, and produced OCI manifest digest
steps.decisionOwner: Worker Core accepts the attempt. Buster reduces node state.
steps.safeStop: After an uncertain push, inspect the intended digest before any rebuild. Do not substitute a tag.

steps.evidenceStatus: This step is a reference. It has no live evidence attached.
steps.component: Buster result import, Nova journal, Redis observers, and Discord
steps.inputIdentity: jobId, result digest, evidence digests, cleanup receipts, and original lifecycle identities
steps.action: Release the fixture lease. Return the bounded result. Verify all imported bytes. Before observers publish derived events and messages, commit Nova terminal state.
steps.outputIdentity: Buster terminal job, release receipt, complete import, Nova terminal run, Redis entry IDs, and Discord message ID
steps.safeStop: Keep the attempt incomplete on digest or cleanup uncertainty. Derived delivery cannot create or change terminal state.

completionCondition: This reference gives a target for a future joined harness. That harness must bind live evidence for all 20 steps to the same identities. These identities include one deployment revision, source revision, Nova run, Prism request and approval, and Buster job. They also include channel identities, network-flow evidence, artifact digests, and cleanup identities. No current command in this document satisfies that condition.
